name: THE X-PLORATOR
description: A serene cosmic exploration game. Read how humanity left a fading Earth in a seven-scene comic prologue, then fly a white and orange explorer through the blue-violet Outer Verge beneath a giant luminous planet: scan crystal asteroids, collect Cryon and Ferrite, return to Haven Outpost, upgrade your ship's modules in the hangar and grow a hexagonal orbital base. One-stick flight with auto-cruise, keyboard, controller and touch.

credits.work: THE X-PLORATOR game code, procedural ships, planet, sky, station, interface and synthesised sound
credits.by: Original work created for THE X-PLORATOR; geometry, shaders and sound generated in code
Original illustrations commissioned by THE X-PLORATOR's owner for this game (AI-assisted); all prologue text is set by the game
